question:
Two different position of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face having '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6d047f9c49d90bbf1207ff82fe0a194750e41df33889c35b9bc16365ddf482c.png]
solution:
Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6d047f9c49d90bbf1207ff82fe0a194750e41df33889c35b9bc16365ddf482c.png] 

 
• Logic: If two dice have same face value in given image than their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number/letter are know as opposite number/letter in dice.
 
• While moving in clockwise direction from common face (3) of dice (1) and dice (2):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e47985195df643214454973afd38b99b4e07da2233834ff6bc15000c45cab0c.png] 

From the both dices:

 
 

 
 
Dice 1

 
 
 
3

 
 
 
1

 
 
 
4

 
 
 

 
 
Dice 2

 
 
 
3

 
 
 
2

 
 
 
5

 
 
 

 

 
• As it is a dice so it Implies that 3 will be on the opposite face of 6.

Hence, **3** is the correct answer.
